tasks.memory: Paging convention in this codebase: page numbers start at 1, not 0, and stop is exclusive like a Python slice. A page past the end returns (total, total) instead of raising, and per_page below 1 raises ValueError.

import pytest
from paging import page_bounds


def test_first_pages():
    assert page_bounds(1, 10, 35) == (0, 10)
    assert page_bounds(4, 10, 35) == (30, 35)


def test_past_end():
    assert page_bounds(5, 10, 35) == (35, 35)
    assert page_bounds(9, 10, 0) == (0, 0)


def test_bad_per_page():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        page_bounds(1, 0, 10)
